english.notes:
(i) This offence is not committed where disclosure of protected information is made for the purposes of: communicating with the director concerned; in order to comply with any requirement of the Companies Act as to particulars to be sent to the registrar or, in accordance with court ordered disclosure under section 244 of the Companies Act 2006 (see section 241(1)).
(ii) Civil financial penalties may be issued by the registrar as an alternative to prosecution for this offence, being a ‘relevant offence’ as defined by section 1132A of the Companies Act 2006.
(iii) Civil financial penalties may be issued by the registrar for this offence being a ‘relevant offence’ as defined by section 1132A of the Companies Act 2006. No criminal proceedings may be commenced against a person in respect of conduct amounting to an offence if the person has already been given a financial penalty by the registrar. Further, no financial penalty may be imposed on a person in relation to conduct amounting to an offence if proceedings in respect of that offence are ongoing or the person has been convicted.
